theoretical_prior_sensitivity.warning: These are illustrative theoretical priors, not probabilities inferred from cosmological observations.

scientific_boundary: Current observations do not identify the far-future model probabilities, vacuum lifetime, finite de Sitter Hilbert-space interpretation, or recurrent properties of a future bounce. Without theoretical priors the marginalized recurrence probability is non-identified beyond the full logical bound [0,1]; this is a partial-identification result, not an estimated probability distribution.

fate_probability_layer.status: Model-dependent inference layer. These weights are normalized posterior model weights only within the declared LambdaCDM-versus-w0waCDM comparison and are not objective probabilities of the universe's ultimate fate.

baseline_model_comparison.interpretation: Equal prior odds over only LambdaCDM and w0waCDM using the Ong, Yallup & Handley DESI DR2 BAO + Planck CMB Bayesian evidence. The numerical uncertainty is the reported evidence-computation uncertainty, not a complete systematic uncertainty or a probability over all cosmological theories.

fate_decomposition_sensitivity.warning: The top-level LambdaCDM versus dynamical-dark-energy weight is data-informed under the stated two-model/equal-prior comparison. The splits below are explicit theory sensitivity assumptions, not measured conditional fate probabilities.

fate_probability_layer.comparison_scope_note: These evidence values are from the Ong, Yallup & Handley Bayesian reanalysis and refer to a restricted LambdaCDM-versus-w0waCDM model set. DESI DR2 Results IV adds Lyman-alpha Alcock-Paczynski/full-shape information and quotes frequentist significances; it is a distinct inferential object and is not substituted for these Bayes factors.
